# C1 Project Card — Candidate Canonical Capability Contract V0.1

## Authorized work

Candidate-only contract construction, deterministic tests, integrity manifest,
structured semantic review and control-plane closeout.

## Hard boundaries

```ini
LEGACY_IMPORT_OR_CALL = FORBIDDEN
LIVE_CAPABILITY_POOL = FORBIDDEN
CAPABILITY_AVAILABILITY = OUT_OF_SCOPE
AGENT_CREATION_OR_COORDINATION = FORBIDDEN
AUTHORITY_ATP_COMMIT_OR_EXECUTION = FORBIDDEN
HISTORY_STATE_RUNTIME_OR_FORMAL_MLM_WRITE = FORBIDDEN
NETWORK_MCP_PROVIDER_BUS_PIPELINE = FORBIDDEN
```

## Success

The project provides a deterministic, immutable candidate definition catalog
with integrity-bound public declarations only.  It does not claim that a
Capability can presently be used.
